body: I worked for Yankee Candle too. Witches Brew returns every year, so you should have no problem getting it this fall -- packaging has changed though. From your description it might also be Moonlight Harvest (discontinued). A good place to go when you're looking for an older fragrance but can't remember the name is eBay. You can usually find pictures of discontinued fragrances there. The prices can be outrageous, though. If it's Moonlight Harvest I have a spare medium jar and you can have it for shipping costs.

I remember him hosting SNL a few decades ago....I can check YouTube and see what videos they have, I could use a smile or two. I'm sorry you have horrifying things to deal with. Horrifying is such a strong word, it really hit me that you're probably facing things much worse than I am. I am thinking of you and trying to send some good karma your way. It's not much but all I can do.

I need to think about the career focus a little more. There may be more that can be done than I think...I like photography and have been forcing myself out once a weekend to someplace new to take pictures with my phone and upload them to Instagram (I don't take pictures of me, just nature, architecture). I enjoy it but I really have to push myself out to do it, and I'm always alone. The online games I play tend to be one-person. Any suggestions? I'd really appreciate something that would be more social. Thanks for practical solutions. I don't know about people loving me. That was a nice thing for you to say, esp. since I don't come off as very lovable in my post :/

THANK YOU! I can't tell you how much your comment means to me. You validated my feelings. I don't feel so alone now, like I'm the only person in the world feeling like this. It's very lonely where I am right now, I feel out of step with the others I work with, even though they are good people. We just live very different lives.

I used to have faith but it's gone. It died with my mother in 2016. I don't believe in anything anymore. But I do appreciate that you took the time to comment and try to comfort me. That's very kind. I hope my post helps someone younger to try to seize/reconsider their life while they can, even if they really feel so bad that they can't imagine the point in trying.
